 The drama inside the Bigg Boss 20 house continues as new controversies add to the tension between the contestants. This time, Love Gill's mother has reacted strongly to Mahi Vij's controversial 'nanga' remark about her daughter during a recent family message task. The controversy started when Mahi Vij allegedly made a comment about Love Gill while talking about her relationship with ScoutOP. Her use of the word 'nanga' did not go down well with Love's family. The comment soon became a topic of discussion, with Love's mother deciding to speak up about it. During her message, Love's mother openly expressed her anger towards Mahi. Defending her daughter, she said, “Nanga kar dungi, par Scout ka lihaaj kar rahi hoon.” Her statement showed that she was unhappy with Mahi's choice of words and the way her daughter was being discussed. She also questioned Mahi's behaviour and said that as a woman, she should understand the importance of respecting another woman's dignity. Her reaction showed the emotional side of the situation, as she came forward to defend her daughter on national television.
 Meanwhile, Mahi Vij appeared upset by the confrontation. She reportedly became emotional and tried to explain her side of the story. The actress also expressed her disappointment over how the situation was being presented and spoke about her concerns regarding her family's reaction to the events inside the house.
 --> 
 The incident has once again brought the relationship between Love Gill, Mahi Vij and ScoutOP into the spotlight. What started as a disagreement between contestants has now turned into a bigger controversy, with their families also getting involved.Love Gill's mother's strong reaction has added another twist to the drama inside the Bigg Boss 20 house. With tensions rising and emotions running high, it remains to be seen how Love and Mahi will deal with the situation in the upcoming episodes.
